title: Brand New Suite! Explore Downtown Nashville!
description:
This is a brand new suite located in the heart of Nashville!
Perfect for all occasions and the whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place.

The suite is just steps from Broadway, the Music City Center, and Nashville’s best honky-tonks.

Enjoy the properties amenities including pool, gym, and lounge.

Walkable to dining, nightlife, and top attractions.

20mins from BNA Airport

Parking $25 per night

PermitT2022050192

The space
The suite comfortably accommodates 4 guests with a queen size bed and two single fold down couches.

Vanity space

Kitchen is equipped with kitchen essentials

Smart TV available for your favorite streaming services

Wifi available

Private balcony

In-unit washer and dryer

Enjoy the amenities the property has to offer such as pool, gym, and lounge.

Guest access
Guests will gain access to the unit with a key fob.
There is one key fob per unit and it will be retrieved from the Key Cafe lockers in the lobby upon arrival.

Guests will receive access and check-in instructions prior to check-in.

Other things to note
Parking is available upon request for one vehicle.
Parking is $25 per night
If you have additional vehicles, you may park the additional vehicles at Guest Parking. Please note the property charges their own guest parking fees.

Early check-in is available upon request and availability. $50 fee

Late check-out is available upon request and availability. $50 fee
